howSelection.title: How selection works
howSelection.heading: How selection works
howSelection.intro: One person each day, chosen at random from everyone eligible. Here is exactly how, with nothing left out.
howSelection.poolBody: Two days before each cycle, shortly before midnight UTC, we freeze the eligible account list and publish its hash. Pool entry requires an active account, age {{age}} by the conservative birth-year rule, accepted community rules, a stable Apple or Google account identifier, a platform-attested unbound device, seven account days, genuine participation, no unresolved review flag, and the choice to take part. These checks raise the cost of duplicate entries; they do not prove that each account belongs to a globally unique person.
howSelection.drawBody: Before drawing, we commit to a cryptographically secure secret seed by publishing its hash. At midnight we use that already-frozen pool and seed, then rank every candidate by an HMAC of their identifier. The first is chosen; the next {{backups}} are backups. Everyone in the list has exactly the same chance.
howSelection.acceptBody: The chosen person is told they were selected and has {{hours}} hours to answer. If they decline or do not answer, we ask the first backup, then the second, then the third. Declining and silence are treated the same way: nothing happens, and the person stays in every future draw.
howSelection.onceBody: Anyone who has been Today’s Human is removed from every future draw. There is no cooldown and no second turn. One human, one day, forever.
howSelection.verifyBody: The pool hash, candidate count, entropy commitment, source, algorithm version and commit time are public. After a cycle goes live we reveal the seed. Anyone can verify its prior commitment, recompute the ordering and confirm the published result. The verification functions are open to everyone.
howSelection.neverPay: Paying us anything. There is no way to buy a better chance, and there never will be.
howSelection.neverFollowers: Follower counts. Nobody has followers here — the product has no such thing.
howSelection.neverBoost: Boosts, promotions or featured slots. None exist.
howSelection.neverSponsor: Sponsors. No sponsor can influence who appears.
howSelection.neverInfluencer: Being already famous. Existing fame is not an input to anything here.
howSelection.neverAlgorithm: Engagement, activity, or how interesting we think you are.
howSelection.safetyBody: Suspended and banned accounts are not in the pool, and a portrait is reviewed by a person before it is published. If a cycle cannot be filled in time, we publish nothing and say so rather than publishing someone unreviewed.
howSelection.footer: These rules come from our Product Constitution. The parts about fairness cannot be amended.

onePerson.title: There is one person here at a time. Treat them that way.
onePerson.body: Today’s Human is not content. They are somebody who agreed to be seen, once, by strangers. Ask them what you would ask a stranger you respected. If you would not say it to them in a room, do not send it here.

askQuestions.title: Ask questions. Do not deliver verdicts.
askQuestions.body: You can ask anything. You cannot use a question to make a statement about someone — their country, religion, body, politics or life. "What do people misunderstand about where you live?" is a question. "Why is your country like that?" is a verdict wearing a question mark. We remove the second kind.

noCompeting.title: Nobody here is competing.
noCompeting.body: There are no followers, no scores, no rankings and no way to pay for attention. Do not use questions, portraits or reports to promote anything — yourself, a business, a cause, or another platform.

beTruthful.title: Tell the truth about who you are.
beTruthful.body: Do not create or operate duplicate accounts, present yourself as somebody else, or enter the draw for another person. Our account, provider and device checks make duplicates harder but cannot prove global human uniqueness. If selected, the story must be your own.

neverAllowed.title: Some things are never allowed.
neverAllowed.body: Harassment, threats or targeting a person or group. Hate directed at people for who they are. Sexual content, and any sexual content involving minors, which we report to the authorities. Encouraging self-harm. Sharing anyone’s private information. Trying to contact Today’s Human outside this app.

protectPeople.title: Protect the person, not the platform.
protectPeople.body: If something here worries you, report it. Reports are read by a person. Reporting is free, always available, and never held against you. If you are unsure, report it and let us decide — that is our job, not yours.

ifSelected.title: If you are selected
ifSelected.body: You will be asked, and you can say no. Declining costs nothing. If you accept: you choose what to share, your country is shown but your city and exact age are yours to withhold, a person reviews your portrait before it is published, and you can ask to be removed from the Archive afterwards.

breakingRules.title: What happens when rules are broken
breakingRules.body: In order: content is removed, the account is suspended, then banned. Serious harm skips to the end and, where required, to the authorities. If you are banned you are out of every future draw. You can dispute a decision and a different person will look at it.

chosen.title: If you are chosen
chosen.heading: What happens if you are chosen
chosen.intro: Almost nobody expects it on the day it happens, so here is the whole of it in advance. Nothing here is a surprise, and nothing is required of you until you say yes.
chosen.acceptBody: A notification, and the invitation waits in the app. You have {{hours}} hours to accept or decline. Declining costs you nothing at all — you stay in the pool exactly as you were, and the next person is asked straight away.
chosen.writeBody: Between {{min}} and {{max}} short questions, and a photograph. Not a biography — ordinary questions with ordinary answers, in your own words and your own language. There is no right answer and nothing to prepare.
chosen.reviewBody: A moderator checks the portrait before it is published. That is a safety check, not an edit: nobody rewrites what you wrote.
chosen.liveBody: For 24 hours you are Today’s Human. People can read your portrait, ask you questions, and keep you in their own archive. Questions are reviewed before they reach you, and you answer only what you want to.
chosen.afterBody: Your day ends and your page stays in the Archive, readable forever. You are never selected again — one human, one day, forever — and you can ask for your entry to be removed at any time.
chosen.never1: Nobody sees how many people read your portrait.
chosen.never2: Nobody can follow you, and there is no way to message you.
chosen.never3: Your answers are never edited, and never translated over.
chosen.never4: No number is ever attached to you.
chosen.reassure: You can leave the draw whenever you like, and rejoin whenever you like.
